text:
Type: tall white bookcase
Use: storing books, files and decor; living room, home office, bedroom
Style: Scandinavian, farmhouse, traditional
Materials: white painted board with a subtle brushed wood-grain texture
Colors: white, soft warm white
Shape: tall narrow open case with five adjustable shelves, small overhanging top, sides extending into short legs, slightly framed front edges, medium visual weight
Feel: fresh, simple, homely, calm
Goes with: light wood floors, pastel walls, linen, rattan baskets; Scandinavian, cottage or farmhouse rooms

product.name: BRUSALI
product.description: Adjustable shelves, so you can customise your storage as needed.
